rules: Do not assign a main legacy feature number without direct source evidence.
Track-local identifiers such as QCS, QTC and IDEAS100 numbers never fill the main Smart Traffic legacy numbering gap.
Unnumbered OCT17 app rows are historical source records, not automatic new canonical features.
Smart-city precursor records can be directly verified while still having zero Smart Traffic Main Legacy count effect.
Cross-project environment records remain excluded from Smart Traffic legacy numbering unless independent Smart Traffic provenance is recovered.
Secondary forensic candidate maps preserve recovery leads without increasing the unified-registry count.
Archive original source artifacts before promoting candidate records to verified historical status when byte-level access is available.
Historical conversation retrieval may support promotion when the retrieved message directly binds project identity, number and feature identity in one coherent source context.
If a source is readable but raw-byte archival is unavailable, register its source type explicitly and do not claim byte-identical repository archival.
Preserve conflicting versions and overlapping source records until canonical reconciliation is independently reviewed.
